title: Refactor Global Variable Usage
problem_statement: Global variables are used extensively, leading to potential maintainability issues.
risk_if_unaddressed: Continued use of global variables could lead to difficult-to-maintain code and potential security issues.
suggested_approach: Refactor code to use dependency injection or encapsulate global state within classes.

title: Mitigate SQL Injection Risks
problem_statement: Dynamic SQL query construction without parameterization poses SQL injection risks.
risk_if_unaddressed: SQL injection vulnerabilities could lead to data breaches and unauthorized data access.
suggested_approach: Use parameterized queries or ORM frameworks to construct SQL queries.
